title.narrative: Food security for vulnerable groups affected by the food price increase

description.narrative: Project Goal (Impact): Increase in food security and resilience of vulnerable populations to the negative impacts of food price increases and to contribute to the promotion of gender equity​ Outcome1: Local climate-resilient food production of target populations is increased"Outcome 2: Incomes of the target group are increased and livelihoods are strengtheningOutcome 3: Malnutrition and undernutrition of vulnerable populations affected by the food crisis is reducedOutcome 4. Gender equity and inclusion in target communities is promoted

The proposed project will build on the successes of the recently completed BMZ SEWOH project , with the specific aim of scaling up and expanding the interventions that proved most effective and relevant in the previous project, in order to increase the food security and resilience of households most affected by rising food prices, and promote gender equity
